prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Compare character traits and select the pet that best fits your desktop workflow."]
1: ["Custom Pet Photo Alignment", "Follow the checklist to ensure your photos produce a crisp, accurate 3D desktop pet.", "Clear front-facing angle & bright lighting"]
2: ["Managing Your Desktop Pet", "Learn how to access your pet from the system tray, toggle desktop visibility, and activate voice commands.", "Got It"]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Here is a quick overview of primary desktop controls and shortcuts.", "Quick Shortcut: Alt + Pet"]
4: ["Tip: Your pet stays active in your system tray even when windows are minimized."]
5: ["Mapping desktop boundaries and display resolution..."]
6: ["Finalizing pet personality traits and official certificate seal..."]
7: ["Look for the pet icon in your system tray to quickly hide, show, or configure desktop settings.", "Tray Icon Active"]
8: ["Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and progress associated with this account.", "Existing Pet Data Will Auto-Sync"]
9: ["Previewing companion sound effects..."]
